\begin{document}
Let $T$ be a fixed tunnelling amplitude, independent of temperature.  For
real $a$ and $c$, the fermionic Matsubara frequencies give the claimed sum
\begin{equation}
T \sum_n \frac{1}{(\mathrm{i}\omega_n-a)(\mathrm{i}\omega_n-c)}
= \frac{n_F(a)-n_F(c)}{a-c} .
\label{eq:transfer-sum}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
